title: Wayland Embedder: Refactor message sending and debug log
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

None specifically, this is a refactoring PR. I guess it could make it harder to send invalid Wayland messages (or at least, make it easier to detect them).

## Additional information

The original code is very messy due to its experimental nature. This is one the first step towards a more maintainable and streamlined implementation.

Main changes include:

 * Message signature parsing. This adds basic safeguards to message construction before sending, such as validating that the number of passed arguments makes sense. It's possible to add more advanced checks.

 * Custom (simplified) debug log. By setting "GODOT_WAYLAND_EMBEDDER_DEBUG" to "1", the embedder will print something similar to libwayland's `WAYLAND_DEBUG` setting.

 * Hand-written wrappers for client events. This is very much incomplete, but the idea is to "test" how a bunch of generated methods would work. We can't keep passing arguments by hand, it makes for some long strings.

 * All debug logs go into stderr now (which is also unbuffered, nice), and the "compile-in" debug macro has been renamed to "verbose", to give space to the runtime logs.

Lastly I've added some notes here and there in the codebase. They aren't technically related to this change, but I felt like it was a good thing to document/point them up for next time.

---

Sorry for the roughness of this PR. I'm afraid that if I start polishing it too much I'll never get anything out of the door. I really like this debug thing and I hope that it will help with basic debugging.
